title: plastic trays
text: plastic trays. I purchased these to make an appetizer tray - worked great.  You get two.  However, don't accidentally drop one.  It will shatter.  They are brittle plastic.  The handles are, well, handy.  Bright white.  Hand wash, of course. Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new inf seem useful.

product_metadata.title: TP Serving Tray with Handles, Large Rectangle Melamine Serving Platter Set of 2, White (17” x 12”)
features: Large Capacity: 17” x 12” rectangle sizing makes the tray large enough to carry bowl and plate sets efficiently. Also, the nesting 2-set design is good for storage.

Lightweight & Durable: Made from 100% high-grade melamine, TP serving trays are lighter than ceramic ones with a delicate porcelain look and feel, a bit weighty compared to plastic ones, more scratch, and shatter-resistant.

Great Texture on the Surface: With a little uneven texture on the surface of the serving tray, it looks sparkling when the specific space is empty. It will bring a great visual experience for you and your family. And no worry that the texture will interfere with the glassware or make it wobble.

Indoor and Outdoor Use: Never worry about breakage and chipping, perfect for household use, outdoor parties or barbecues, poolside dining, patio entertaining, also a choice for picnic, camping, travel trailer, motorhome, RV, and camper.

Easy to Care for: Safe to clean in the top-rack of a dishwasher, heat resistant and cold insulated but NOT MICROWAVABLE. Backed by TP 1-year normal warranty, 3-year Break & Chip Resistant Guarantee, and our all-round customer service.
